paper_id: Federated Probabilistic Preference Distribution Modelling with Compactness Co-Clustering for Privacy-Preserving Multi-Domain Recommendation
title: Federated Probabilistic Preference Distribution Modelling with Compactness Co-Clustering for Privacy-Preserving Multi-Domain Recommendation
motivation: 隐私法規使跨域共享用戶評分不可行;現有CDR假設可訪問跨域交互數據
problem_framing: 定義為隱私保護多域推薦問題,用戶評分矩陣無法跨域直接共享
key_insight: 用高斯分布代替點嵌入建模用戶偏好,通過全局服務器聚合分佈
method_signature: FPPDM: GCN建模本地分佈 + 全局服務器 Wasserstein 聚合
evaluation_criteria: HR@5/10, NDCG@5/10 在 Douban 和 Amazon 數據集
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: FedMF浅层模型无法刻画复杂用户-物品关系;现有方法只用embeddings而非分布
evidence_for_taste: such knowledge sharing process will break the privacy protection policy
most of current CDR models only utilize embeddings rather than distributions
FedMF only adopted a shallow model and thus cannot depict the complex user-item relationship well
the scattered latent distributions will hurdle the model performance
Previous methods mainly focus on the simple embedding situation
thinking_moves: 指出现有CDR方法隐私假设不成立,需重新定义问题约束
用概率分布代替确定性嵌入捕捉用户偏好的不确定性
图神经网络建模本地交互结构,全局服务器聚合分布
通过谱约束rank(L)=N-M将聚类目标转化为谱优化问题
extraction_notes: IJCAI 2023, 浙江大学作者群;论文完整包含动机、方法、实验和局限性分析
